post.originalText:
Now that I have gotten all the rampaging creation needs out of me for today, maybe I can focus on a Caturday thing lol, maybe.

Prompt below for those interested.

The walk in the prompt works just fine, I think Dimitri D Don is just so pretty Grok keeps mistaking him for a woman. Took me a while to get that part to stop happening. Feel free to adjust whatever desired, this is just to help smooth walking animations, as much as I can anyway.

Dimitris Walk

The video must use: realistic [hair type] mens hair animation, realistic clothing animations, realistic walking animations, 0 limping, 0 jumping, 0 skipping, one foot in front of the other, slow hunters walk, with mild shoulder movement matching, realistic human skeleton animation, 0 rubber joints, 0 disconnected limbs, 0 disconnected shapes, quick camera cuts, an up-down angle, an down-up angle, a walk by cut, ending the full walking scene by zooming in on [C/M] face as [C/M] gives a partial semi half smile smile to the viewer, Hollywood level production quality, Hollywood level camera work, realistic expressions, object placement recognition, object placement tracking, character placement recognition, character placement tracking, 0 talking, 0 voice over, dark, slow, instrumental, phonk music, do not remove items, do not give [C/M] feminine aspects, do not give [C/M] feminine hair.
